test_flava_classification_forward: test the FLAVA model forward pass for classification with multimodal, image-only, and text-only scenarios
test_flava_pretraining_forward: test the FLAVA model forward pass for pretraining with masked language modeling and image-text matching
test_flava_model_image_text: test the FLAVAModel forward pass with both image and text inputs and verify encoder outputs
test_flava_model_masked_inputs: test the FLAVAModel forward pass with masked image patches and masked text tokens
test_flava_model_unimodal: test the FLAVAModel forward pass with image-only or text-only inputs and verify empty outputs for missing modalities
